title: Store Replacement Authorization: Plan Share Formula
content:
**The plan's share of a covered replacement at a Crestline store that the holder of a Road Hazard Protection certificate authorizes in person on the day of the technician's inspection.**

- **Service facts.** The service date, wheel position, store, odometer and measured tread of the authorized replacement are those of the Crestline tread inspection of the covered set recorded today with the wear pattern damage.
- **Full-replacement period.** The authorized replacement falls in the full-replacement period when at least the plan term less the plan's full-replacement months remain as whole calendar months from the service date to the expiration date, counting to the same day of the month, which is the same as the service date falling on or before the effective date plus the full-replacement months.
- **Authorization coverage percentage.** 100 when the replacement falls in the full-replacement period and the tread worn (the tire line's original tread depth on its Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty line, less the measured tread) is at most the plan's full-replacement wear figure; otherwise the measured tread less the plan's coverage tread limit, times 100, divided by the original tread depth less the coverage tread limit, rounded down to a whole percent. Points added to the authorization coverage percentage apply only to a prorated percentage, and a prorated percentage with every point that applies is held between 0 and 100; an authorization coverage percentage of 100 stays 100.
- **Authorization price.** The covered set's unit price on its original tire ticket.
- **Plan's share.** The authorization coverage percentage times the authorization price, divided by 100 and rounded half up to the cent, rounding only this final figure.

The plan figures named are those of the plan's term and replacement benefit schedules.

**Worked example (hypothetical).** A 24-month plan with a 6-month period, a 2/32 wear figure and a 2/32 coverage limit; a line with 11/32 new tread. Inspection today shows 10/32 with 20 whole months left: 20 is at least 24 less 6, and 1/32 is worn, so the percentage is 100 and the share equals the unit price. With 15 whole months left and a reading of 6/32: outside the period; 4 times 100 divided by 9 is 44.44, rounded down to 44; on a unit price of 109.00 the share is 47.96.
